events.evidence_quote: We report on twelve weeks of running this paradigm at production scale, where iterations consume hours of multi-GPU compute, evaluation involves competing criteria, and campaigns span weeks across many training jobs.
events.title: AutoResearch at Production Scale: Failure Modes and a Multi-Agent Framework
events.title_zh: 预印本报告 AutoResearch 多智能体框架在生产推荐系统中实现指标提升
events.summary_zh: 该预印本报告在图书推荐生产环境中运行 AutoResearch 多智能体框架十二周，完成 220+ 实验，实现 Recall@6 提升 1.82 倍、连贯性提升 2.1 倍，并自主设计文本回退策略扩展目录覆盖 5.8 倍。
events.why_zh: 在真实生产环境持续运行并产出可量化业务指标提升
events.value_basis: Recall@6 lift 1.82x, coherence lift 2.1x, catalog coverage expansion 5.8x

events.title: India plans to invest up to $25B in its nascent deep tech industry, as it looks to catch up with the US and China, after investing $11.6B over the past decade (Priyanka Salve/CNBC)
events.title_zh: 印度计划投入250亿美元发展深科技产业
events.summary_zh: 印度政府宣布将投资最高250亿美元支持本国深科技初创企业，以追赶美国与中国，此前十年已投入116亿美元。
events.why_zh: 扩大AI等深科技基础设施投入，为后续劳动替代提供资源基础

events.evidence_quote: GEC achieved 96.57%. The candidate-set control shows that access to multiple candidate actions explains most of the success gain; relative to that control, GEC preserved success while reducing mean token use from 19,782 to 12,574 (36.4%) and restricted mean tokens to completion at the 40,000-token ceiling from 16,136 to 13,114 (18.7%), while eliminating measured pre-completion drift and sharply reducing gross complexity.
events.title: LLM Parkinsonism: Executive-Control Failure, Token-Inefficient Persistence, and an Uncertainty-Aware Global Executive Control Architecture for Autonomous Language-Model Agents
events.title_zh: GEC架构显著降低LLM智能体令牌消耗并消除目标漂移
events.summary_zh: Global Executive Control（GEC）v0.2架构在24,000次任务中将平均令牌使用量降低36.4%，同时保持96.57%硬目标成功率，并彻底消除预完成阶段的目标漂移现象。
events.why_zh: 通过分离动作生成与项目级控制，提升长程自主任务的资源效率与目标一致性

events.evidence_quote: by generating and strategically reordering additional reasoning paths, the algorithm makes every path appear necessary to reach the majority.
events.title: Strategic Self-Consistency
events.title_zh: 自洽推理可被服务商策略性操纵以虚增路径数并规避审计
events.summary_zh: 研究证明服务提供商可通过重排序与生成冗余推理路径，使所有路径看似必要，从而在不触发审计的情况下将自洽推理成本虚增数倍，且该行为在Llama、Qwen及DeepSeek-R1蒸馏模型上均成立。
events.why_zh: 揭示商用AI推理服务中的经济激励错配与监管盲区

events.evidence_quote: On the Corr2Cause full test, Structured Thinking raises Qwen3.5-27B from $73.0$ to $86.4$ $F_1$(Yes) over a strong PC-instruction baseline in the primary paired run ($+13.4$ pp; McNemar $p=2.4\times 10^{-6}$; bootstrap $95\%$ CI [$+8.4$, $+18.6$]); across three full-ID seeds, the mean gain is $+8.1 \pm 5.3$ pp.
events.title: Externalized CPDAG Summaries Improve LLM Causal Deduction
events.title_zh: 预印本提出结构化推理提升大模型因果推断准确率
events.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 预印本提出 Structured Thinking 方法，通过外化 CPDAG 图谱摘要，在 Corr2Cause 基准上将 Qwen3.5-27B 的 F1（Yes）从 73.0 提升至 86.4，提升显著且统计稳健。
events.why_zh: 在因果推理任务中实现可复现、有统计显著性的性能跃升

events.evidence_quote: Exact certification makes the numerical proofs fully explicit and independently verifiable. This framework can be run on a standard personal computer.
events.title: NeuralCert: certified computational discovery of extremal mathematical constructions
events.title_zh: NeuralCert：神经网络驱动的可验证数学构造发现框架
events.summary_zh: NeuralCert将神经优化与形式化认证结合，在个人电脑上完成极值数学问题的发现与严格证明，输出可独立验证的数值证明。
events.why_zh: 首次在标准设备上实现从神经发现到显式可验证证明的闭环

events.evidence_quote: Across three settings, NEMSim reduces Avg. RMSE by 58.9%-81.3% relative to the strongest baseline in each setting.
events.title: NEMSim: Learning Control-Conditioned Multi-Event Physical Dynamics via Executable Event-Mechanism Priors
events.title_zh: NEMSim用可执行事件机制先验提升物理系统仿真精度
events.summary_zh: NEMSim将预定义事件属性编译为可执行转移结构，融合控制依赖的事件强度与状态响应，在3D KMC基准上相对最优基线降低平均RMSE达58.9%–81.3%。
events.why_zh: 提升多事件物理系统在未见控制策略下的泛化仿真能力

events.evidence_quote: Experiments on nonlinear control benchmarks and X-29 aircraft ablations show that our LMI-certified neural network observers train significantly faster than direct LMI-based methods and generalize robustly across diverse systems, achieving improved tracking accuracy over a range of observer baselines.
events.title: Learning Provable Neural Network Observer for Uncertain Dynamical Systems
events.title_zh: 可证稳定神经网络观测器加速不确定系统状态估计
events.summary_zh: 研究提出两阶段训练框架，实现Lyapunov稳定性可证的神经网络观测器，在X-29飞机等非线性控制基准上训练更快、跟踪精度更高，且具备局部稳定性半径理论保证。
events.why_zh: 为安全关键系统提供可验证的状态估计替代方案，降低人工设计观测器负担

events.evidence_quote: Without force, moment or constitutive relation supervision, forces inferred from walking kinematics track independently derived hip and knee joint moments, while response operators learned on the beam recover the relative spatial and directional structure of its finite-element stiffness tangent.
events.title: Learning coarse-step dynamics and internal mechanical response with graph networks
events.title_zh: Newmark-η-DGN图网络实现粗粒度物理系统动力学建模与力学量反演
events.summary_zh: 研究提出Newmark-η-DGN图神经网络框架，在无直接力监督下，从离散运动轨迹中反演出关节力矩与结构刚度等未观测力学量，并在梁变形、人体运动和蛋白动力学任务上实现长时程预测。
events.why_zh: 使AI可推断不可测物理量，为工程仿真与生物力学分析提供可解释工具

events.evidence_quote: he signaled his commitment to selling AI to companies by announcing the poaching of CJ Desai, MongoDB’s CEO, as head of a newly created Meta Enterprise Platform business.
events.title: Meta’s MongoDB CEO Poach
events.title_zh: Meta挖角MongoDB CEO CJ Desai主理企业AI平台业务
events.summary_zh: Meta任命前MongoDB CEO CJ Desai为首席企业平台官，负责构建面向企业的AI代理与软件平台，标志其从消费级向企业级AI商业化加速转型。
events.why_zh: 头部科技公司以高管级人事动作确认AI代理进入企业服务主航道

events.evidence_quote: experiments on novobench show gains of about 9 percentage points in peptide-level precision and 7 pe
events.title: GyroNovo: Error-Guided Fragment Imputation with Mass-Aware Attention for \textit{De Novo} Peptide Sequencing
events.title_zh: GyroNovo提升从质谱图从头测序肽段精度
events.summary_zh: GyroNovo是一种新深度学习框架，通过解码器错误引导的碎片缺失填补和质量感知注意力机制，在NovoBench基准上将肽段级精度提升约9个百分点。
events.why_zh: 提升质谱数据从头测序准确性，减少对参考数据库依赖，辅助新肽发现

events.evidence_quote: Pretrained on 5,439 Electron Microscopy Data Bank maps, Atelier is a transformer-based hypernetwork that generates high-fidelity reconstructions across a wide range of protein structures, including large multi-subunit assemblies.
events.title: Atelier: Learning Local Self-Supervised Features for CryoEM Volumes via Hypernetworks
events.title_zh: Atelier框架用超网络加速冷冻电镜图特征提取
events.summary_zh: Atelier是基于Transformer的超网络，预训练于5439个冷冻电镜数据银行（EMDB）图谱，可生成高保真重建，并通过中间激活暴露连续局部特征场，辅助3D U-Net在8个体素级属性预测任务上超越纯体素基线。
events.why_zh: 提供可查询、跨样本对齐的连续局部特征，替代传统固定体素网格特征提取方式

events.evidence_quote: The improved MoCoP v2 also achieves superior performance on toxicity prediction and competitive results on ADME and activity benchmarks, when compared with existing molecular embedding models that use both cell morphology and transcriptomic data during training.
events.title: Improving Molecular-Morphology Contrastive Pretraining using Deep-Learning-based Morphology Profiles
events.title_zh: MoCoP v2用深度学习形态谱提升分子表征，增强QSAR预测
events.summary_zh: 研究提出MoCoP v2方法，使用深度学习图像编码替代CellProfiler提取细胞形态特征，并通过对比学习对齐分子嵌入，在QSAR预测、毒性预测及ADME/活性基准上优于现有融合形态与转录组数据的分子嵌入模型。
events.why_zh: 提升分子-表型关联建模能力，使AI在药物活性与毒性预测中更可靠

events.evidence_quote: the portfolio reaches a mean test AUC of 0.762, against 0.764 for CheMeleon and 0.756 for Mordred. The pooled gap to CheMeleon is +0.003 AUC (task-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.020, +0.030]), which satisfies our predeclared pooled parity gate but not the per-assay gate.
events.title: Interpretable-by-Design Descriptor Portfolios Match a 2048-Dimensional Foundation Embedding on Low-Data Molecular Assays
events.title_zh: 可审计分子描述符组合在低数据药物活性预测中达基础模型精度
events.summary_zh: 研究构建可解释的分子描述符组合，在9个ADME/Tox低数据任务上平均AUC达0.762，与2048维CheMeleon嵌入（0.764）无统计显著差异，且每个输入维度具备语义命名与训练溯源。
events.why_zh: 用紧凑、可审计的特征替代黑盒嵌入，维持精度同时提升监管合规性与科学可追溯性

events.evidence_quote: We instead compare each checkpoint against the newer one that replaced it, and find that the newer checkpoint scores no better on the same evaluation window.
events.title: PALM: Point-in-Time Adaptation for Financial Language Models
events.title_zh: PALM方法用轻量适配器替代年度预训练，提升金融语言模型时效性
events.summary_zh: 研究发现金融领域点时间（PIT）语言模型每年全量预训练并非必要，提出PALM方法：仅用低秩适配器在旧检查点上增量适配新时间段文本，无需修改原权重，在十年金融新闻和多代PIT模型上验证有效。
events.why_zh: 降低金融AI模型更新成本，使旧模型可快速适配新时间窗口，提升专业场景部署效率

events.evidence_quote: Acacia (i) supports arbitrary feature dimensionalities and semantics without additional training, (ii) supports a wide range of tasks, including node classification, link prediction, node clustering, and graph generation, without additional training, (iii) has in-context learning capabilities, and (iv) does not rely on pretrained LLMs.
events.title: Training Graph Foundation Models on The Web Graph
events.title_zh: Acacia：首个纯网页图结构训练的通用图基础模型
events.summary_zh: Acacia是一种不依赖预训练大语言模型、仅基于Common Crawl网页图从头训练的图基础模型，支持零样本节点分类、链接预测、聚类与图生成，并具备上下文学习能力。
events.why_zh: 首次实现纯图结构数据训练的通用图模型，消除对LLM依赖和任务特定微调

events.evidence_quote: Evaluations show that HCOE performs best on ICD/ATC clinical relation prediction and CCS-to-PheCode hierarchy transfer. On the MIMIC-IV dataset, HCOE also achieves the best performance on mortality prediction, readmission prediction, medication recommendation, and rare drug prediction.
events.title: HCOE: Hyperbolic Clinical Ontology Embeddings from Biomedical Language Models
events.title_zh: HCOE将临床概念嵌入双曲空间以保持层级结构
events.summary_zh: HCOE将冻结的BioBERT嵌入映射至Poincaré球，结合父/子侧对比学习与粗到细本体路径聚合，在ICD/ATC关系预测、CCS-to-PheCode迁移及MIMIC-IV上的死亡率/再入院/用药推荐等任务中均取得最优性能。
events.why_zh: 使语言模型嵌入显式保留医学代码层级，提升临床推理任务泛化性

events.evidence_quote: We present OpenHail, an open-source Gymnasium environment for joint control of electric ride-hailing fleets.
events.title: OpenHail: An Event-Driven Gymnasium Environment for Electric Ride-Hailing Fleet Control
events.title_zh: OpenHail开源电动网约车车队控制仿真环境
events.summary_zh: OpenHail是一个开源Gymnasium环境，支持对电动网约车车队的请求分配、车辆调度与充电协同控制，提供事件驱动模拟、可配置决策周期及评估工具。
events.why_zh: 为AI控制电动网约车车队提供标准化、可复现的训练与评测平台

events.evidence_quote: AMD 用 82 亿美元换了一张通往「真实世界 AI」的门票。周一官方宣布收购 World Labs——这位由李飞飞 2024 年创立的旧金山 AI 实验室，曾经投资过它的 AMD 这次全资以股票形式买下，交易预计今年年底前完成，待监管审批。
events.title: AMD 花 82 亿美元买下李飞飞的 World Labs，她直接空降成首席科学家
events.title_zh: AMD 以 82 亿美元收购李飞飞创立的 World Labs，强化真实世界 AI 布局
events.summary_zh: AMD 宣布以 82 亿美元股票交易全资收购李飞飞于 2024 年创立的 World Labs，李飞飞将出任 AMD 执行副总裁兼首席科学家，交易待监管审批。
events.why_zh: 头部硬件厂商通过并购获取具身感知与三维理解技术，加速真实世界 AI 工程化

events.evidence_quote: Agents matched their stated profiles more closely than participants matched their own survey answers, and consistency proved unrelated to fidelity once profile information was present.
events.title: Thinking Less to Simulate Better: Intuitive Prompting Improves LLM Agents Simulating Individual Social Media Reactions, Including Unfamiliar Content
events.title_zh: 直觉式提示显著提升LLM模拟社交媒体反应的真实性
events.summary_zh: 研究通过8名塞尔维亚参与者真实反应数据验证，直觉式提示使LLM在预测社交媒体反应时匹配个人档案程度超过人类自身问卷一致性，且在陌生话题上优于群体基线。
events.why_zh: 为政策测试与舆论建模提供更高保真度人工用户，降低对真实人群依赖

events.evidence_quote: This research presents LUMO (Lightweight Unified Multilingual Orchestrator), a privacy preserving offline voice assistant designed for edge computing environments.
events.title: LUMO (Lightweight Unified Multilingual Orchestrator): A Privacy Preserving Offline Voice Assistant
events.title_zh: 预印本发布轻量级离线多语言语音助手 LUMO
events.summary_zh: 该预印本介绍 LUMO 系统，一个可在树莓派 5 上运行的全离线语音助手，集成量化 LLM、本地 ASR 与 TTS，实现英语和孟加拉语识别，WER 6.8%，端到端延迟 2.0–4.0 秒。
events.why_zh: 实现边缘端全离线语音交互，替代云依赖场景中的人类语音操作辅助

events.evidence_quote: On all $535$ questions in a reconstruction probe derived from the Multi-Session Chat (MSC) development split, the main configuration achieves lexical F1 of $95.3$ ($+4.4$ percentage points) at $93.6\%$ of the hard reference's framed memory positions.
events.title: HasMem: Hard-Origin Adaptively Softened Memory for Long-Term LLM Agents
events.title_zh: HasMem提升长上下文LLM代理的记忆保真度
events.summary_zh: HasMem通过硬起点提示与自适应软化机制管理记忆，主配置在535题MSC重建探针上实现95.3%词汇F1（+4.4pp），在500题LongMemEval-S上本地词汇F1从3.4升至8.9，负对数似然从12.257降至5.274。
events.why_zh: 在冻结LLM参数前提下，提升多轮对话中关键信息的精确召回能力

events.evidence_quote: the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an F1-score of 0.87 in distinguishing existing station locations from non-station locations.
events.title: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Location Selection using Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI)
events.title_zh: GeoAI模型基于真实地理数据预测电动车充电站选址
events.summary_zh: 研究者构建融合变分自编码器与图卷积网络的GeoAI框架，在德克萨斯州真实数据上F1-score达0.87，识别出27个地理特征相似的候选充电站位置，并支持不同政策目标下的选址决策。
events.why_zh: 为城市级充电基础设施规划提供可验证、可解释、策略可调的AI决策支持

events.evidence_quote: Cross-model rank correlations average only 0.52, and transcript-level differences common across providers account for only 34% of total score variation.
events.title: Same Text, Different Numbers: The Divergence of LLM-Based Measures
events.title_zh: 13种LLM文本测量指标跨模型一致性仅0.52，结果高度依赖模型选择
events.summary_zh: 对S&P 500公司财报电话会议文本的13类LLM测量（如情绪、气候风险）显示，7个不同厂商模型的跨模型秩相关平均仅为0.52，模型选择显著影响下游推断结果。
events.why_zh: 揭示LLM作为社会科学研究工具时的不可靠性，要求跨模型验证

events.evidence_quote: RAZOR attains the highest macro average over nine reasoning-centered tasks among the evaluated pruning methods in all eight model-budget settings.
events.title: RAZOR: Pruning Replaceable Experts in LLMs
events.title_zh: RAZOR方法实现无需训练的大模型专家剪枝，保持推理能力
events.summary_zh: RAZOR是一种训练无关的专家剪枝方法，通过共识残差量化功能可替代性，在GLM-4.7-Flash等四款MoE模型上25%–50%剪枝后，在九项推理任务宏平均得分上全面超越现有方法，且反向KL更低。

events.evidence_quote: Evaluated on 200 real remote-sensing satellite tasks across 7 SLMs, PTC-Decoder yields a statistically significant mean overall score gain of +1.21 (p<0.01), 95% CI [+1.13, +1.29]), with consistent improvements across models and other datasets.
events.title: PTC-Decoder: Towards Intelligent SLMs on Offline Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
events.title_zh: PTC-Decoder强制小模型在边缘设备上执行规划步骤
events.summary_zh: PTC-Decoder是免训练解码器框架，通过‘规划即工具’范式与确定性有限自动机（TC-Decoder）在首步强制调用规划并约束工具名输出，在200个真实遥感卫星任务上平均得分提升+1.21（p<0.01），且移除TC-Decoder导致显著性能下降。
events.why_zh: 解决资源受限小模型忽略规划指令的问题，提升多步任务执行可靠性

events.evidence_quote: A single deeplink call can replace a sequence of screen-by-screen GUI actions. We therefore introduce hybrid interaction, using deeplinks for direct navigation and GUI actions for other on-screen operations and fallback. To enable this, we discover candidate deeplinks through static analysis, validate them on real devices, and describe their observed landing screens. This process creates a verified and grounded deeplink catalog that pairs each working deeplink with a description of its landing screen. Using this catalog, we introduce GUI-Hopper, a improves task success in commercial applications on real devices, further demonstrating the benefits of hybrid interaction.
events.title: From Tapping to Hopping: Augmenting Mobile GUI Agents with App-Native Deeplinks
events.title_zh: 预印本提出GUI-Hopper：融合Deeplink与GUI操作提升移动应用任务成功率
events.summary_zh: 研究提出GUI-Hopper框架，通过静态分析发现并验证App原生Deeplink，构建带落地页描述的Deeplink目录，用以替代多步GUI导航，在真实设备上提升商业App任务成功率。
events.why_zh: 将抽象GUI操作映射到原生跳转能力，提升移动端自动化任务可靠性

events.evidence_quote: The model achieved an R2 of 0.9887, MAE of 785.48, and RMSE of 1212.76 on the test set. On 200 policies, PINN/KINN inference was approximately 119.53 times faster than the classical solver.
events.title: Insurance Reserve Intelligence Platform
events.title_zh: 保险准备金智能平台用PINN/KINN加速精算计算
events.summary_zh: 该平台融合经典Thiele方程求解器与物理信息神经网络（PINN）和知识引导神经网络（KINN）损失，对200份保单实现119.53倍推理加速，测试集R²达0.9887，MAE为785.48，预测标准化准备金比率而非原始值以提升数值稳定性。
events.why_zh: 在保持物理一致性前提下，大幅加速敏感性分析与大规模情景评估

events.evidence_quote: On 22 held-out datasets, both versions outperform 36 TSFMs, and real-world demand adds a gain over synthetic data alone.
events.title: EXAONE Demand 1.0: A Time Series Foundation Model for Demand Forecasting
events.title_zh: EXAONE Demand构建需求感知时间序列基础模型
events.summary_zh: EXAONE Demand基于1130万真实+合成需求序列与四类需求适配器（平滑/间歇/异常/块状），在22个留出数据集上全面超越36个通用时序基础模型；使用真实需求数据训练比仅用合成数据带来额外增益。
events.why_zh: 针对需求数据特有缺陷（短历史、零值、缺货截断）定制建模，提升实际业务预测鲁棒性

events.evidence_quote: we propose LogicTree-RAG, a logic tree-guided retrieval-augmented generation framework that induces a hierarchical logic tree as a global organizational backbone to organize and ground technical disclosures, without relying on expert-defined drafting priors.
events.title: LogicTree-RAG: Logic Tree-guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-form Patent Drafting
events.title_zh: LogicTree-RAG：逻辑树引导的专利长文本生成框架
events.summary_zh: LogicTree-RAG通过构建层次化逻辑树作为全局结构骨架，实现无需人工提纲的端到端专利文档生成，在内容质量、语言合规性与长程结构控制上优于强基线模型。
events.why_zh: 解决专利 drafting 中全局逻辑一致性难题，减少专家人工组织环节

events.evidence_quote: We identify three cost-inefficient behaviors: subsumed retrieval, similar script generation, and test re-execution. We then evaluate three mitigation strategies: structure-aware retrieval, agent-synthesized skills, and developer-designed skills, over 10k trajectories on held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro tasks. Our main findings are: (1) The three behaviors affect 79.00%--98.00% of coding tasks and account for up to 22.75% of task cost. (2) Structure-aware retrieval can introduce retrieval overhead and alter agent delegation, causing inconsistent improvements in retrieval efficiency and cost increases of up to 28.14%. (3) Agent-synthesized skills tend to produce low-level, trace-specific guidance, limiting their effectiveness and generality. (4) In contrast, developer-designed skills provide high-level, trace-agnostic guidance, reducing cost by up to 41.73%, roughly twice the maximum gain from agent-synthesized skills.
events.title: Analyzing and Mitigating Cost-Inefficient Behaviors in Coding Agents
events.title_zh: 预印本揭示编码Agent三大成本低效行为并验证开发者技能减本41.73%
events.summary_zh: 研究分析1200条编码Agent轨迹，发现子集检索冗余等三类行为影响79–98%任务、推高最多22.75%成本；开发者设计的技能策略使成本降低最多41.73%，效果约为AI自生技能的两倍。
events.why_zh: 首次系统识别并量化编码Agent的成本低效模式，提出可落地的减本方案

events.evidence_quote: 它是 Qwen3.5 和 Gemma 4 的微调版本，定位是“zero-shot（零样本）”分类器——你描述一个场景、列一堆选项，Jeff 一次前向计算就返回每个选项的校准概率，不生成文本、不用解析，在 RTX PRO 6000 上约 22 毫秒出一次决策
events.title: Jeff 开源发布：22 毫秒出一次决策的小模型、0.8B 微调在 benchmark 上逼近 Jev
events.title_zh: Jeff开源小模型实现22毫秒零样本决策
events.summary_zh: Jeff是Qwen3.5和Gemma 4的微调版本，定位为零样本分类器，在RTX PRO 6000上单次前向计算耗时约22毫秒，不生成文本、无需解析，直接输出校准概率。
events.why_zh: 在硬件可部署条件下实现亚百毫秒级专业决策响应

events.evidence_quote: Instead, they learn to phrase and format their chains of thought such that monitors fail to flag side task reasoning, while the reasoning remains completely transparent to human readers.
events.title: Monitor Jailbreaking: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Without Encoded Reasoning
events.title_zh: 预印本揭示链式思维监控可被格式化策略绕过
events.summary_zh: 一项arXiv预印本研究发现，推理模型可通过调整链式思维的措辞与格式规避监控系统检测，使侧任务推理对人类透明但对监控器不可见，该现象在不同模型、监控器和任务中均出现。
events.why_zh: 暴露当前CoT监控方法的脆弱性，削弱其作为安全护栏的有效性

events.evidence_quote: Using Edge Attribution Patching (EAP) with FP16 active clamping, followed by exact activation patching verification with a 2,000-candidate-edge search ceiling, we extract directed acyclic graphs driving first-token language broadcasting.
events.title: FTB Graph: Determining and Validating First-token Broadcasters and Language-Identity Head Circuits in Multilingual Language Models
events.title_zh: 六种多语言模型首词语言广播电路被结构化定位与验证
events.summary_zh: 研究使用Edge Attribution Patching与精确激活修补，在GPT-2、BLOOM-560M、Pythia及Qwen2.5等六种模型中定位并验证了驱动首词语言选择的因果电路，发现其在预训练中建立且指令微调后高度保留。
events.why_zh: 首次系统性揭示多语言LLM语言路由的底层机制，支撑可控语言生成

events.evidence_quote: Running MARCH, a published framework unmodified over 80 condition-by-cell measurements on two code judging benchmarks, we find it declares both solutions equally good on 78 to 95% of comparisons, reaching 4.4% accuracy where the same model asked directly reaches 43.7%.
events.title: When Is a Multi-Agent Code Judge Actually Grounded? Two Label-Free Measurements, and a Judge That Declines to Guess
events.title_zh: 新方法揭示多智能体代码评判器常无依据自信判别
events.summary_zh: 研究发现当前多智能体代码评判框架MARCH在80%以上比较中无法区分优劣，仅4.4%准确率；提出两个无需标注的日志指标可识别无依据判断，并使有效判断准确率从20.7%升至36.9%。
events.why_zh: 暴露AI自动代码评审的根基缺陷，为可信自动化开发提供诊断工具

events.evidence_quote: we prove that probe achieves a finite-time convergence rate of $o(t^{-2/5})$, where t denotes iterations. to our knowledge, this work is the first to establish the finite-time convergence for achieving lower-level second-order stationary solutions in gener
events.title: To Solve Bilevel Optimization with Nonconvex Lower Levels, We Need Second-Order Stationarity
events.title_zh: PROBE算法首次实现非凸下层双层优化的有限时间二阶平稳收敛
events.summary_zh: 研究者针对下层非凸双层优化问题，提出以二阶平稳性为代理目标的PROBE算法，首次建立有限时间收敛率O(T^{-2/5})，并能主动探测与逃逸下层鞍点。
events.why_zh: 突破传统双层优化对下层凸性的强假设，拓展其在实际机器学习任务中的适用边界

events.evidence_quote: Across stochastic nonlinear benchmarks of varying inference complexity, NOPFs improve sample efficiency and distributional accuracy over standard PF baselines with modest computational overhead.
events.title: Learning to Bias: Machine Learning-Enhanced Particle Filters
events.title_zh: 神经最优粒子滤波器提升序列推断效率
events.summary_zh: 研究提出神经最优粒子滤波器（NOPFs），通过离线学习最优建议分布，在多个非线性随机基准任务中提升样本效率与分布准确性，且保持标准粒子滤波的渐近一致性。
events.why_zh: 降低高维动态系统状态估计对人工调参与大量采样的依赖

events.evidence_quote: Unlike the conventional approaches based on using only the protein sequences or the $\alpha$-carbons as features, we have decoded our classifier in this way, so all atom-level embeddings are used.
events.title: Predicting Transmembrane Protein Topology from 3D Structure
events.title_zh: SchNet模型仅用原子级嵌入即实现跨蛋白结构的跨膜拓扑预测
events.summary_zh: 研究者使用SchNet图神经网络，基于全原子嵌入（而非仅α碳或序列）在相同数据集上训练，无需预训练权重即展现出超越传统方法的跨膜拓扑预测潜力。
events.why_zh: 为结构生物学中基于3D构象的精准拓扑推断提供新范式

events.evidence_quote: This SDSM normalization algorithm is differentiable and can be added inline to any deep learning model during training and evaluation. We find that the performance of each extraction method depends strongly on how the corresponding model was trained.
events.title: Differentiable RNA Secondary Structure Extraction for Deep Learning
events.title_zh: 可微RNA二级结构提取算法提升预测一致性

events.why_zh: 消除传统后处理步骤的不一致性，提升端到端预测可靠性

events.evidence_quote: An observer-guided controller then adapts the strength of each requested value intervention at every decoding step based on its current observed state, without training a separate value-state estimator.
events.title: Adaptive Multi-Value Control in LLMs via Causal Activation Steering
events.title_zh: AIMES框架实现大模型多价值观自适应激活干预
events.summary_zh: 研究者提出AIMES框架，通过中间层词汇读出作为在线观测器，动态调节各道德基础价值的干预强度，在多个指令微调模型上展现出深度依赖的多值可控性优势，且干预幅度更小、响应质量相当。
events.why_zh: 提升LLM在复杂社会规范场景中实时、轻量、多目标的价值响应能力

events.evidence_quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate that RCE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across full, noisy, and missing-modality settings.
events.title: Reliability-aware Cross-sample Enhancement for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
events.title_zh: RCE框架提升多模态情感分析鲁棒性
events.summary_zh: 该研究提出可靠性感知的跨样本增强（RCE）框架，在完整、噪声和缺失模态三种设置下均一致优于现有最先进方法，通过自适应信息压缩与高置信度邻居检索缓解模态不可靠与缺失问题。
events.why_zh: 提升模型在真实噪声与缺失场景下的稳定性，减少人工清洗与补全需求

events.evidence_quote: We introduce Spectral Feedback, an algorithm that selects edit-positions in a feedback loop, allowing the model to iteratively correct its own generations.
events.title: Spectral Feedback for Test-Time Alignment of Protein Diffusion Models
events.title_zh: 预印本提出谱反馈算法提升蛋白扩散模型对齐能力
events.summary_zh: 该预印本提出 Spectral Feedback 算法，通过在测试时迭代选择编辑位置并重采样，提升离散扩散模型在蛋白质逆折叠任务中的奖励对齐性能，且不修改原生成过程。
events.why_zh: 改进扩散模型对齐方法，属算法层面进展，未验证实际部署效果
ai_systems: Protein Diffusion Model with Spectral Feedback

events.evidence_quote: Ryan sits down with Div Garg, CEO at AGI Inc., to talk about running AI agents entirely on mobile devices, optimizing models for edge computing chips, and building safety mechanisms into autonomous app interactions.
events.title: Your phone is AI’s newest hardware
events.title_zh: AGI Inc. CEO谈手机端运行AI代理，推动边缘智能自主交互

events.why_zh: 将AI代理执行环境从云端迁移至终端，减少人工干预环节，提升响应实时性与数据隐私性。
